title: Water cycle — science sheet
facts: Water evaporates from oceans, lakes, and puddles when the sun heats it.
Warm water vapor rises, cools, and condenses into tiny droplets that make clouds.
Precipitation is rain, snow, sleet, or hail falling from clouds.
The water cycle has no beginning or end — water keeps moving through earth, air, and sky.
